in_sanskrit.name: आवश्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: That which is bound to happen, cannot be avoided

in_hindi.name: आवश्य
in_hindi.long_meaning: अविर्द्ध होना, अविकल होना, अविभाग्य होना

in_marathi.name: Avashya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avashya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avashya is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'avas' meaning 'unavoidable' or 'inevitable'. The prefix 'asha' means 'wish' or 'hope'. Together, Avashya signifies one who is inevitable or indispensable.
